pr_summary: CustomOutput configuration rendering does not produce expected line format. The fix changes CustomOutput class inheritance from FlatCommand to LineCommand, ensuring the output is emitted as a single line with colon prefix. Additional bug fixes in commands.py (Gauge error message), utils.py (alt_names handling), ravenpy.py (Path handling), and coords.py (import cleanup).
candidate_smoke_commands: python -c 'from ravenpy.config.commands import CustomOutput; c = CustomOutput(time_per="YEARLY", stat="AVERAGE", variable="PRECIP", space_agg="ENTIRE_WATERSHED"); print(c.to_rv())'

notes: RavenPy is a Python wrapper for the Raven hydrological modeling framework. The fix addresses CustomOutput rendering by changing inheritance from FlatCommand to LineCommand. LineCommand.to_rv() produces single-line output with colon prefix and proper spacing, while FlatCommand inherits default Command.to_rv() which produces nested output. Python 3.9+ required. Tests use pytest with pytest-xdist for parallelization. Test data is downloaded from remote repository during test runs.
